page.layout: One printed page (right page of the opening). Running head at top centre. Main text in one column, with a diagram (cuboid with labelled numbers) set into the text at left, beside which a short column of text runs on the right. Catchword/signature line "M 5 Cubus" at the foot of the text block. No marginal notes in the text block; the left edge carries fragments of the facing page, not transcribed.

p.i: inuento, & eiusdem quoti quadrato triplum, quotumq; cubicè multiplices, factosq; (distinctis ordinibus, ut quaelibet nota factoribus suis respondeat) additos, à dato numero subducas: atq; posterius diuisionis, opus, quot puncta superfuerint, iteres: Cubi latus inuentum erit.

Artificium est ex Theoremate, quod Ramus imitatione Euclidei de quadratis confecit, in hunc modum. Si recta secetur in duo segmenta: Cubus totius aequabitur cubis segmentorum, & duplici solido ter comprehenso à quadrato sui segmenti & reliquo segmento.

Vt ci linea, quae est 13, secta est in 10 & 3: cuius igitur totius aequatur cubis segmentorum 10 & 3, scilicet 1000 & 27, duplicibus item solidis seu parallelepipedis, quorum terna aequalem inter se solidi tatem habent, nimirum minorum quodlibet 90, factum ex quadrato segmenti 3 in alterum 10 multiplicato, atq; haec Parallelepipeda tria simul sumpta faciunt 270. Trium vero maiorum quodlibet continet 300, facti à quadrato maioris segmenti 10 in 3 multiplicatum, atq; illa simul sumpta constituunt 900.

page.notes: Diagram of a cuboid with corner letters a, b, c, d, e, f and numbers 300, 90, 10, 31, 90, 300, 90, 300 printed on its faces; transcribed only as described. Left-edge fragments belong to the facing page and are omitted. The reading of the diagram labels is approximate.
